faq.question: How long does a behavioural insight engagement take in education?
faq.answer: An insight sprint runs 4 to 6 weeks. Redesign and media work follow in phases, each focused on one step from interest to application.

faq.question: Do you work with university and school admissions cycles?
faq.answer: Yes. We plan around intakes, deadlines and open days, so changes land when learners and parents are actually deciding.

faq.question: How do you measure impact on enrolment behaviour?
faq.answer: Against one agreed behaviour per phase, such as an enquiry made or an application finished. The baseline is agreed before work starts.

faq.question: Is learner data kept safe?
faq.answer: We sign an NDA before any data is shared and work within your security and privacy policies.

cta.p: A 15-minute fit call. We bring a first read of where your learners hesitate.
